correctness.rationale: Direct exact coefficient arithmetic verified F mod 2=((X+Y)(Y+Z)(Z+X))^2, mod 3=Q times four sign hyperplanes, and mod 5=2Q^3+(XYZ)^2. The p=2 reduction is three concurrent doubled lines, hence 3q+1 points. At p=3 the smooth conic meets four rational tangent lines at four tacnodes, and the four lines have six distinct pairwise nodes: 5(q+1)-10=5q-5. At p=5 the partial derivatives exhaust six coordinate cusps and four sign-vector ordinary nodes; independent symbolic expansion at [1:1:1] gives 2u^2+3uv+2v^2 with nonsquare discriminant 3 mod 5. Bezout rules out geometric splitting because cusps are unibranch and four nodes supply at most four cross-component intersections, below the minimum five for a reducible degree-six curve. Delta-invariant 4+6=10 forces genus-zero normalization. Four rational nonsplit nodes exchange their branches under odd Frobenius and split under even powers, yielding q+1-4(-1)^n; p=3 and p=5 projective stabilizers inject into S4 of four special points and contain signed coordinate permutations of order 24. The three all-extension zeta functions then follow. Independent verification covered coefficient identities and tangent discriminant; extension universality rests on geometry, not finitely many fields.
